"""Composition, adoption and durable job identity, without loading an image model."""
from copy import deepcopy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'source'))
import context_infill as infill
import local_style as style


class ContextInfill(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.folder = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.preset = json.loads(style.DEFAULT_PRESET.read_text())
        self.caption = 'A registered city with varied real roof colours.'
        self.source = self.folder / 'source.png'
        y, x = np.indices((1024, 1536))
        self.source_pixels = np.stack([x % 256, y % 256, (x + y) % 256], axis=2).astype(np.uint8)
        Image.fromarray(self.source_pixels).save(self.source)

    def test_grid_covers_exact_unaligned_native_source(self):
        self.assertEqual(infill.starts(1024), [0])
        self.assertEqual(infill.starts(1803), [0, 779])
        self.assertEqual(infill.starts(3456), [0, 608, 1216, 1824, 2432])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            infill.starts(1023)

    def test_overlap_keeps_old_interior_and_transitions_to_new_prediction(self):
        canvas = np.zeros((1024, 1536, 3), np.uint8)
        done = np.zeros((1024, 1536), bool)
        infill.composite(canvas, done, np.full((1024, 1024, 3), 40, np.uint8), 0, 0)
        infill.composite(canvas, done, np.full((1024, 1024, 3), 200, np.uint8), 512, 0)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(canvas[:, :896], 40)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(canvas[:, 1024:], 200)
        self.assertEqual(canvas[500, 1023, 0], 199)
        self.assertTrue(done.all())

    def test_plan_only_never_resolves_or_submits_models_and_binds_identity(self):
        out = self.folder / 'planned'
        with patch.object(style, 'queue_style', side_effect=AssertionError('inference')), patch.object(style, 'model_paths', side_effect=AssertionError('model lookup')):
            result = infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption, plan_only=True)
            self.assertFalse(result['queued'])
            self.assertEqual(result['windows'], 2)
            self.assertFalse((out / 'windows').exists())
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'changed'):
                infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption + ' different', plan_only=True)
        changed = deepcopy(self.preset)
        changed['inference']['seed'] += 1
        path = self.folder / 'changed.json'
        style.write(path, changed)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'changed'):
            infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption, preset_path=path, plan_only=True)

    def experiment(self):
        folder = self.folder / 'old'
        grid = [[0, 0], [512, 0]]
        settings, base, adapter = self.preset['inference'], self.preset['base'], self.preset['adapter']
        prompt = infill.prompt_for(self.caption, self.preset)
        plan = {'source_sha256': style.digest(self.source), 'size': [1536, 1024],
                'box': [0, 0, 1536, 1024], 'window': 1024, 'feather': 128,
                'windows': grid, 'prompt': prompt, 'recipe': {
                    'model': settings['queue_route'], 'base_revision': base['revision'],
                    'adapter_sha256': adapter['sha256'], 'steps': settings['steps'],
                    'guidance': settings['guidance'], 'seed_base': settings['seed'], 'scale': str(settings['adapter_scale'])}}
        canvas, done = self.source_pixels.copy(), np.zeros((1024, 1536), bool)
        for index, (x, y) in enumerate(grid):
            wd = folder / 'windows' / f'w{index:02d}-x{x}-y{y}'
            wd.mkdir(parents=True)
            Image.fromarray(canvas[y:y + 1024, x:x + 1024]).save(wd / 'input.png')
            raw = np.full((1024, 1024, 3), 40 + index * 100, np.uint8)
            Image.fromarray(raw).save(wd / 'raw-klein9b.png')
            argv = ['imagine', prompt, str(wd / 'input.png'), '-m', settings['queue_route'],
                    '--steps', str(settings['steps']), '--seed', str(settings['seed'] + index),
                    '--width', '1024', '--height', '1024', '--reference-max-dimension', '1024',
                    '--model', f'/cached/{base["revision"]}', '--guidance', str(settings['guidance']),
                    '--lora', f'/cached/{adapter["revision"]}/adapter.safetensors', str(settings['adapter_scale'])]
            style.write(wd / 'run.json', {'returncode': 0, 'argv': argv, 'job': f'job-{index}',
                'input_sha256': style.digest(wd / 'input.png'),
                'outputs': {str(wd / 'raw-klein9b.png'): style.digest(wd / 'raw-klein9b.png')}})
            infill.composite(canvas, done, raw, x, y)
        Image.fromarray(canvas).save(folder / 'map.png')
        plan['map_sha256'] = style.digest(folder / 'map.png')
        style.write(folder / 'plan.json', plan)
        return folder

    def test_adoption_replays_exact_pixels_without_inference_and_resumes(self):
        experiment = self.experiment()
        out = self.folder / 'replay'
        with patch.object(style, 'queue_style', side_effect=AssertionError('inference')):
            result = infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption, adopt=experiment)
            self.assertEqual(result['sha256'], style.digest(experiment / 'map.png'))
            self.assertEqual(infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption)['sha256'], result['sha256'])
            raw = out / 'windows/w01-x512-y0/raw.png'
            Image.new('RGB', (1024, 1024), 'red').save(raw)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'prediction changed'):
                infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption)

    def test_adoption_rejects_wrong_context_prediction_and_schedule(self):
        experiment = self.experiment()
        old = experiment / 'windows/w01-x512-y0'
        Image.new('RGB', (1024, 1024), 'red').save(old / 'input.png')
        record = json.loads((old / 'run.json').read_text())
        record['input_sha256'] = style.digest(old / 'input.png')
        style.write(old / 'run.json', record)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'expected source'):
            infill.paint(self.source, self.folder / 'bad-context', self.caption, adopt=experiment)
        plan = json.loads((experiment / 'plan.json').read_text())
        plan['recipe']['steps'] = 8
        style.write(experiment / 'plan.json', plan)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'schedule differs'):
            infill.paint(self.source, self.folder / 'bad-schedule', self.caption, adopt=experiment)

    def test_keep_mask_protects_source_pixels_and_skips_fully_kept_windows(self):
        # Open water must stay the source: an all-white window gets no job, a mixed one is restored where white.
        mask = np.zeros((1024, 1536), np.uint8)
        mask[:, :1024] = 255
        keep = self.folder / 'keep.png'
        Image.fromarray(mask).save(keep)
        jobs = []
        def painted(receipt, path, **kwargs):
            jobs.append(path.parent.name)
            raw = path.parent / 'raw.png'
            Image.new('RGB', (1024, 1024), 'white').save(raw)
            receipt.update(state='art-ready', art=[{'path': str(raw), 'sha256': style.digest(raw)}])
        out = self.folder / 'kept'
        with patch.object(style, 'style_plan', return_value={'backend': 'test'}), patch.object(style, 'queue_style', side_effect=painted):
            result = infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption, keep=keep)
        self.assertEqual(jobs, ['w01-x512-y0'])
        art = np.array(Image.open(result['image']))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(art[:, :1024], self.source_pixels[:, :1024])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(art[:, 1024:], 255)
        self.assertIn('keep_sha256', json.loads((out / 'plan.json').read_text())['identity'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'changed'):
            infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption, plan_only=True)
        Image.fromarray(mask[:, :1000]).save(keep)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'source dimensions'):
            infill.paint(self.source, self.folder / 'wrong-size', self.caption, keep=keep, plan_only=True)

    def test_interrupted_ambiguous_submission_is_never_requeued(self):
        out = self.folder / 'resume'
        # Simulate interruption after durable intent but before a queue ID was captured.
        original_queue = style.queue_style
        def interrupted(receipt, path, **kwargs):
            receipt['job'] = {'id': None, 'status': 'submitting'}
            style.write(path, receipt)
            raise RuntimeError('interrupted')
        with patch.object(style, 'queue_style', side_effect=interrupted):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption, backend='imagine')
        runner = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('must not submit'))
        def resumed(receipt, path, **kwargs):
            return original_queue(receipt, path, run=runner, **kwargs)
        with patch.object(style, 'queue_style', side_effect=resumed):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'ambiguous'):
                infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption, backend='imagine')
        runner.assert_not_called()

    def test_windows_prepared_before_models_run_once_setup_completes(self):
        out, repo = self.folder / 'early', self.folder / 'repo'
        with patch.object(style, 'imagine_path', return_value=None), patch.object(style, 'ROOT', repo), \
                patch.object(style, 'model_paths', side_effect=ValueError('no weights')):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'setup.sh --models'):
                infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption)
        python = repo / 'outputs/image-runtime/bin/python'
        python.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        python.touch()
        def worker(argv, **kwargs):
            path = Path(argv[-1])
            receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
            self.assertIn('/base', receipt['style_plan']['native_argv'])
            raw = path.parent / 'art/raw.png'
            raw.parent.mkdir()
            Image.new('RGB', (1024, 1024), 'white').save(raw)
            style.write(path.parent / 'native-result.json', {'ok': True, 'job_id': receipt['job']['id'],
                        'image': str(raw), 'sha256': style.digest(raw)})
            return SimpleNamespace(pid=123)
        with patch.object(style, 'imagine_path', return_value=None), patch.object(style, 'ROOT', repo), \
                patch.object(style, 'model_paths', return_value=('/base', '/adapter')), \
                patch.object(style.subprocess, 'Popen', side_effect=worker) as launch:
            self.assertEqual(infill.paint(self.source, out, self.caption)['state'], 'art-ready')
        self.assertEqual(launch.call_count, 2)

    unittest.main()

        downloads, export_sizes = {}, []

        class Response:
            def __init__(self, payload=None, content=b''):
                self.payload, self.content = payload, content
            def raise_for_status(self): pass
            def json(self): return self.payload

        def request(url, params=None, timeout=None):
            if url == service:
                return Response({'maxMosaicImageCount': 1, 'maxImageWidth': 256, 'maxImageHeight': 256})
            if url.endswith('/query'):
                left,bottom,right,top = map(float,params['geometry'].split(','))
                count = int(np.ceil((right+32)/16)-np.floor((left+32)/16)) * int(np.ceil((top+32)/16)-np.floor((bottom+32)/16))

            if url.endswith('/exportImage'):
                left,bottom,right,top = map(float,params['bbox'].split(','))

"""Feed films stay inside the map, share one viewport across the wipe, loop and carry no text."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from PIL import Image, ImageChops

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/'source'))
import social


def manifest():
    return {'title': 'Test city', 'width': 1200, 'height': 900, 'opening_landmark': 'hall',
            'landmarks': [{'id': 'hall', 'x': 500, 'y': 400}, {'id': 'edge', 'x': 1199, 'y': 1}]}


def recipe(**changes):
    return {'size': [160, 200], 'fps': 10, 'loop': True, 'shots': [
        {'seconds': 1, 'path': [{'at': 'hall'}], 'wipe': [.5, 1.02]},
        {'seconds': 2.1, 'path': [{'at': 'hall'}, {'at': 'edge', 'width': 400}, {'at': 'hall'}]},
        {'seconds': 1, 'path': [{'at': 'hall'}], 'wipe': [1.02, .5]}], **changes}


class SocialTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unlabelled_places_need_an_explicit_recipe(self):
        data = {**manifest(), 'landmarks': []}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'map-coordinate shots'):
            social.default_recipe(data)
        explicit = recipe(shots=[{'seconds': 1, 'path': [{'at': [600, 450]}]}])
        self.assertEqual(social.SocialPlan(data, explicit).verify()['result'], 'pass')

    def test_every_frame_stays_inside_and_the_last_returns_to_the_first(self):
        plan = social.SocialPlan(manifest(), recipe())
        proof = plan.verify()
        self.assertEqual((proof['frames_checked'], proof['maximum_on_screen_words']), (41, 0))
        self.assertEqual(proof['loop_closure_error'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(plan.frame(0)[1], .5)
        edge = plan.frame(20)[0]
        self.assertAlmostEqual(edge.left + edge.width, 1200)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(edge.top, 0)
        broken = recipe()
        broken['shots'][-1]['wipe'] = [1.02, .4]
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            social.SocialPlan(manifest(), broken).verify()
        # A fully photographic first frame differs from an all-art last frame.
        broken['shots'][0]['wipe'] = [0, 1.02]
        broken['shots'][-1]['wipe'] = [1.02, 1]
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            social.SocialPlan(manifest(), broken).verify()

    def test_zoom_needs_an_explicit_square_pixel_limit(self):
        close = recipe()
        close['shots'][1]['path'][1]['width'] = 100
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'View width'):
            social.SocialPlan(manifest(), close)
        self.assertEqual(social.SocialPlan(manifest(), {**close, 'pixel_zoom': 2}).verify()['result'], 'pass')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unknown landmark'):
            social.SocialPlan(manifest(), {'shots': [{'seconds': 1, 'path': [{'at': 'missing'}]}]})

    def test_wipe_layers_use_one_transform_and_native_views_are_exact(self):
        art = Image.effect_noise((1200, 900), 60).convert('RGB')
        plan = social.SocialPlan(manifest(), recipe())
        view, wipe = plan.frame(0)
        still = social.render(art, art, view, None)
        self.assertEqual(still.tobytes(), art.crop((420, 300, 580, 500)).tobytes())
        split = social.render(art, art, view, wipe)
        self.assertIsNone(ImageChops.difference(split, still).crop((84, 0, 160, 200)).getbbox())
        self.assertIsNone(ImageChops.difference(split, still).crop((0, 0, 76, 200)).getbbox())
        zoomed = social.sample(art, social.Viewport(420, 300, 80, 100, 160, 200))
        self.assertEqual(zoomed.tobytes(), art.crop((420, 300, 500, 400)).resize((160, 200), Image.Resampling.NEAREST).tobytes())

    def test_a_freshly_made_place_plans_from_its_source_manifest(self):
        """`make` binds only the source hash. The art hash is checked where a manifest records one."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            folder = Path(folder)
            Image.new('RGB', (1200, 900), (90, 120, 90)).save(folder/'art.png')
            Image.new('RGB', (1200, 900), (120, 120, 120)).save(folder/'source.png')
            data = {**manifest(), 'credits': 'Test credits', 'source_sha256': social.digest(folder/'source.png')}
            (folder/'source.json').write_text(json.dumps(data))
            (folder/'shots.json').write_text(json.dumps(recipe()))
            args = argparse.Namespace(manifest=folder/'source.json', image=folder/'art.png', source=folder/'source.png',
                                      recipe=folder/'shots.json', output=folder/'film.mp4', plan_only=True, overwrite=False)
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                self.assertEqual(social.export(args)['result'], 'pass')
            plan = json.loads((folder/'film.plan.json').read_text())
            self.assertEqual(plan['image_sha256'], social.digest(folder/'art.png'))
            (folder/'source.json').write_text(json.dumps({**data, 'image_sha256': '0' * 64}))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'do not match the manifest hashes'):
                social.export(args)

    def test_bundled_examples_plan_from_their_landmarks(self):
        for city in ('dc', 'edinburgh'):
            data = json.loads((ROOT/f'examples/{city}.json').read_text())
            for chosen in (social.default_recipe(data), json.loads((ROOT/f'examples/{city}-social.json').read_text())):
                proof = social.SocialPlan(data, chosen).verify()
                self.assertGreaterEqual(proof['source_wipe_frames'], 1)
                self.assertLess(proof['loop_closure_error'], 1e-9)

    def test_dc_feed_film_opens_on_finished_art_then_sweeps_the_source(self):
        data = json.loads((ROOT/'examples/dc.json').read_text())
        plan = social.SocialPlan(data, json.loads((ROOT/'examples/dc-social.json').read_text()))
        hook = 3 * plan.fps
        self.assertEqual({plan.frame(index)[1] for index in range(hook)}, {None})
        self.assertEqual(plan.frame(hook)[1], 0)
        self.assertEqual(plan.shots[3]['first'], hook)
        anchors = {point['id']: (point['x'], point['y']) for point in data['landmarks']}
        for second, mark in enumerate(('capitol', 'washington-monument', 'white-house')):
            view = plan.frame(second * plan.fps + plan.fps // 2)[0]
            x, y = view.project(*anchors[mark])
            self.assertTrue(0 < x < plan.width and 0 < y < plan.height, mark)
            self.assertLessEqual(view.width, 720)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

class Camera:
    width, height = 128, 160

    def project(self, points):
        x, y, z = np.asarray(points).T
        return np.column_stack(
            [64 + 2 * (x - y), 150 - 2 * (z + 0.4 * (x + y)), x + y + 0.2 * z]
        )


class RecordingRaster(Raster):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(Camera(), {"background_rgb": (0, 0, 0)})
        self.surfaces = []

    def triangle(self, xyz, color, *args, **kwargs):
        self.surfaces.append((np.asarray(xyz), color, kwargs.get("shader")))
        return super().triangle(xyz, color, *args, **kwargs)

    def test_clip_conserves_plane_winding_area_and_linear_camera_depth(self):
        spec = facade()
        for triangle, fraction in [
            (np.array([[-1.0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 4], [0, 2, 4]]), 0.25),
            (np.array([[-1.0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 2, 4]]), 0.75),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(triangle=triangle.tolist()):
                fragments = clip_wall(triangle, np.zeros(2), spec)
                normal = np.cross(triangle[1] - triangle[0], triangle[2] - triangle[0])
                area = 0
                for fragment in fragments:
                    self.assertTrue((fragment[:, 2] <= 2).all())
                    cross = np.cross(
                        fragment[1] - fragment[0], fragment[2] - fragment[0]
                    )
                    self.assertGreater(np.dot(cross, normal), 0)
                    area += np.linalg.norm(cross) / 2
                    for point in fragment:
                        barycentric = np.linalg.lstsq(
                            np.vstack([triangle.T, np.ones(3)]),
                            np.r_[point, 1],
                            rcond=None,
                        )[0]
                        self.assertTrue((barycentric >= -1e-12).all())
                        np.testing.assert_allclose(
                            barycentric @ triangle, point, atol=1e-12
                        )
                        np.testing.assert_allclose(
                            Camera().project([point])[0, 2],
                            barycentric @ Camera().project(triangle)[:, 2],
                            atol=1e-12,
                        )
                self.assertAlmostEqual(area, np.linalg.norm(normal) / 2 * fraction)

        from shapely.geometry import shape, Point
        record=next(r for r in json.loads((ROOT/'cities/landmarks/edinburgh.json').read_text())['structures'] if r['kind']=='gothic_spire')
        class Mesh:
            def __init__(self):self.triangles=[]

        mesh=Mesh();gothic_spire(mesh,shape(record['geometry']),record)
        xyz=np.concatenate(mesh.triangles);polygon=shape(record['geometry'])
        self.assertLessEqual(max(Point(p).distance(polygon) for p in xyz[:,:2]),1e-8)
        self.assertEqual(xyz[:,2].min(),record['base_m'])
        self.assertEqual(xyz[:,2].max(),record['top_m'])
        height=record['top_m']-record['base_m']
        for centre in record['massing']['outer_turret_centres_m']:
            nearby=np.linalg.norm(xyz[:,:2]-centre,axis=1)<1.3
            self.assertLessEqual(xyz[nearby,2].min(),record['base_m']+.01)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(xyz[nearby,2].max(),record['base_m']+.48*height-.01)
        # Intersections of the actual mesh with two height planes retain the
        # broad lower silhouette and upper body, rather than the old needle.
        camera=Camera(json.loads((ROOT/'cities/edinburgh.json').read_text())['surface']['camera'])
        for fraction,minimum_width in ((.22,45),(.60,20)):
            plane=record['base_m']+height*fraction;points=[]
            for tri in mesh.triangles:
                for a,b in zip(tri,np.roll(tri,-1,axis=0)):
                    if (a[2]-plane)*(b[2]-plane)<0:
                        points.append(a+(b-a)*(plane-a[2])/(b[2]-a[2]))
            self.assertGreaterEqual(np.ptp(camera.project(points)[:,0]),minimum_width)

        record=next(r for r in json.loads((ROOT/'cities/landmarks/edinburgh.json').read_text())['structures'] if r['kind']=='gothic_spire')
        centre=np.array(shape(record['geometry']).centroid.coords[0])
        axis=np.array(record['massing']['axis_unit']);axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
        across=np.array([-axis[1],axis[0]])
        class Front:
            width,height=256,256
            def project(self,points):
                p=np.asarray(points);xy=p[:,:2]-centre;z=p[:,2]-record['base_m']
                return np.c_[128+(xy@axis)*5,240-z*3,-(xy@across)]
        raster=Raster(Front(),{'background_rgb':(230,240,250)})
        gothic_spire(raster,shape(record['geometry']),record)
        sample=lambda x,z:raster.rgb[int(240-z*3),int(128+x*5)]
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(sample(0,8),[230,240,250])
        for x,z in ((0,17),(-4.2,8),(4.2,8)):
            self.assertLess(sample(x,z).max(),100)

    def test_zero_text_default_keeps_actual_credits_in_sidecar(self):

        plan = video.FilmPlan(data, seconds=2, fps=30)

        self.assertNotIn('OpenStreetMap', video.credits_text(data))
        data['film'] = {'opening_credit': 'Any title'}

            video.FilmPlan(data)
